item.title: Packers Re-Sign K Lucas Havrisik To Practice Squad
item.description: The Green Bay Packers announced Friday that they signed K Lucas Havrisik to their practice squad. The Packers waived Havrisik a few days ago after carrying him on their active roster the last few weeks.
